C1679.title: Hades PyPI Attack: 19 Packages Poisoned to Auto-Run Bun Credential Stealer
C1679.summary: In June 2026, the Hades malicious campaign placed 19 packages and 37 malicious wheels on PyPI, using *-setup.pth for automatic execution, downloading Bun, and running an obfuscated JavaScript credential stealer. Propagation mechanisms should distinguish stolen tokens from OIDC trusted publishing according to source wording; claims about lateral spread through OIDC trust configuration or implanting build artifacts require full original support.
